sentences.text: The assumption that RBI requires UCBs to charge at least 2% on pre-payment of MSE loans is not supported by the cited directions, because the applicable RBI direction says a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises.

For cases other than those covered by that no-charge direction, the RBI direction says pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of the UCB, and for term loans they shall be based on the amount being prepaid.
The bank’s own MSE business loan sanction letters state pre-payment charges of 2% of the amount prepaid, but that policy applies only where the RBI direction does not prohibit charges.
I could not confirm from the evidence whether the specific loan falls within the RBI no-charge category, because the sanctioned amount or limit and the sanction or renewal date are not provided.
